alerts.title: Declining Brand Impressions
alerts.description: Branded search impressions dropped 92.0% compared to the prior 28-day window (210 vs 2639).
alerts.recommendation: Verify homepage indexing status, sitemap freshness, and schema markup to restore brand search appearance.

alerts.title: Declining Brand Clicks
alerts.recommendation: Check whether third-party or sub-page results are cannibalising clicks away from the homepage.

alerts.title: Brand Ranking Deterioration
alerts.description: Average branded search position is 10.3 (expected top position 1.0 - 2.0).
alerts.recommendation: Inspect brand entity signals, homepage canonical declaration, and robots.txt accessibility.

alerts.title: Low Branded CTR
alerts.description: Branded search CTR is 6.2%, which is below the expected benchmark of 25%+ for navigational brand queries.
alerts.recommendation: Review SERP snippet appearance in Google Search Console to confirm title and description relevance.
